provenance.clerk_text: Filed 45 years of monthly precipitation (Precipitation Corrected, mm/day) for Mexico City, Mexico, 1981-01 to 2025-12, averaged over 9 points. Source: NASA POWER Monthly & Annual API, accessed 2026-11-14.
